items.docs: Fetches all automation workflow rules within an account in descending order of creation, with optional pagination (start and limit).

info.name: Creates a new automation workflow rule.

items.docs:
Creates a new automation workflow rule. Ensure that you check the available triggers, conditions, and actions to use valid options.

Use the following endpoints to check which options are available before creating a rule:
- `/triggers` – lists available triggers
- `/conditions` – lists available conditions
- `/actions` – lists available actions

items.docs: Fetches a specific automation workflow rule.

info.name: Updates an existing automation workflow rule.

items.docs: Updates an existing automation workflow rule.
Deletes an automation workflow rule by its ID.

info.name: Updates the status of an existing automation workflow rule.

items.docs: Updates the status of an existing automation workflow rule. The status must be one of the following: `PUBLISHED` or `PAUSED`.

info.name: Fetches a list of available automation workflow triggers.

items.docs: Fetches a list of available automation workflow triggers. Note: The `RelativeDate` trigger must be used with the `Archived` condition.

info.name: Fetches a list of available automation workflow conditions.

items.docs: Fetches a list of available automation workflow conditions. Some conditions accept only specific predefined terms, which are included in the response for reference. Note: The `Archived` condition requires the `RelativeDate` trigger.

info.name: Fetches a list of available automation workflow actions.

items.docs: Fetches a list of available automation workflow actions. Note: Only actions that the authenticated user has permission to use are included in the response. For example, actions requiring specific features or roles may be omitted if the user lacks access.
